/ THE HIGH COURT OF MEGHALAYA: AT SHILLONG
NOTIFICATION
Dated, the 29th October,2026
No, HCM.I1/34/Pt.IV/2014/Estt/113:- Pursuant to order dated 15.10.2025 passed by the
Hon’ble Supreme Court of India in M.A. Nos. 1889-1891/2025 in Civil Appeal Nos.3640-
3642 of 2025 { Arising out of SLP (C) Nos.8490-8492 of 2020} titled ''Periyammal (Dead)
through LRS & Ors. Vrs. V. Rajamani & Am. Etc.” and in compliance thereof, the Hon’ble
Chief Justice, as an interim measure, is hereby pleased to designate the Secretaries, District
Legal Services Authorities in the concerned districts of the State as Member Secretaries of
the District Execution Cells (DEC).
Copies of order dated 25.05.2026 and 15.10.2026 is enclosed herewith for kind information
and necessary action.
